cases.label: Alor Setar falling tree power surge
cases.folder: CLM-2023-09814 Alor Setar falling tree power surge

proximate_cause.cause: power surge from a fault on the supply network
sequence: An angsana tree with root decay on the Jalan Langgar road reserve, about 350 metres from the risk, falls at about 3:30 pm on 19 September 2023; no thunderstorm or strong wind on record
The tree falls across the overhead low voltage lines
Line fault on the feeder serving Taman Uda
Overvoltage surge on the feeder
Electrical appliances and air-conditioner control boards in the house damaged; the tree never touches the property
proximate_cause.intervening_event: The tree fell about 350 metres away across the public overhead line and never touched the insured property; the feeder fault that followed sent the overvoltage surge to the appliances.

cases.not_priced_reason: No basis to price. The proximate cause, a surge on the supply network, is insured nowhere in the policy, so there is no cover to quantify at any figure.

facts.fact: The tree fell on the overhead power line on Jalan Langgar, about 350 metres from the risk.
facts.source: Adjuster's report, Investigation, Cause and origin; TNB outage record

facts.fact: The tree did not touch the house, compound, walls, gate or fence; no branch or object reached the property.
facts.source: Adjuster's report, Investigation, Cause and origin; Findings, Damage found per item

facts.fact: Appliances damaged by overvoltage on the supply feeder.
facts.source: Adjuster's report, Investigation, Reports relied on; technician reports

facts.fact: No storm that afternoon; the tree had root decay.
facts.source: Adjuster's report, Investigation, Reports relied on

facts.fact: FP513 on the schedule.
facts.source: Schedule, Endorsements and clauses
